title: Glossary of terms used in optical technology
clause_1_scope: 1,1 This standard gives the definitions of terms used in optical technology, but does not include the more commonly used mechanical engineering terms.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Ready Mixed Paint, Marking, Quick Drying, For Marking With Rubber Stamps- Specification (Third Revision)

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
